tasks.subject: Task 0: Security Fixes
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Remove the AdSense script block and convert script.js to an ES module, eliminating the GDPR data leak and window scope exposure.

**Files:**
- Modify: `index.html` (lines 17–18 and 286)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `index.html` contains no reference to `pagead2.googlesyndication.com` or `adsbygoogle`
- [ ] The `script.js` script tag has `type="module"` and no `defer` attribute
- [ ] Opening the page in browser: DevTools → Network shows zero requests to `*.googlesyndication.com`
- [ ] DevTools → Console: `window.currentXmlDoc` returns `undefined`
- [ ] Tool still converts a ZUGFeRD PDF successfully end-to-end

**Verify:** Open page. DevTools → Network: no googlesyndication requests. Console: `window.currentXmlDoc` → `undefined`. Upload ZUGFeRD PDF → conversion succeeds.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["index.html"], "verifyCommand": "open index.html in browser; DevTools Network: no googlesyndication; Console: window.currentXmlDoc === undefined", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no AdSense script in index.html", "script.js tag has type=module", "window.currentXmlDoc is undefined in console", "conversion still works"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: CSS Design System Rewrite
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace styles.css entirely with a token-based system supporting Dark+Indigo (default) and light mode via prefers-color-scheme.

**Files:**
- Modify: `styles.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `:root` defines all design tokens as CSS custom properties
- [ ] `@media (prefers-color-scheme: light)` block overrides tokens for light mode
- [ ] No `backdrop-filter` anywhere in the file
- [ ] Dark mode: deep navy background, indigo accents
- [ ] Light mode: `#f1f5f9` background, white card surfaces, same indigo accent

**Verify:** DevTools → Rendering → toggle `prefers-color-scheme`. `grep -n 'backdrop-filter' styles.css` → no output.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["styles.css"], "verifyCommand": "grep -c backdrop-filter styles.css && DevTools Rendering toggle prefers-color-scheme", "acceptanceCriteria": ["CSS custom properties defined in :root", "light mode override block present", "no backdrop-filter", "visual switch confirmed in both modes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: HTML Layout Restructure
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the two-column grid with a single-column form wrapping two step sections, and update Ko-Fi hint text.

**Files:**
- Modify: `index.html`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] No `.app-main` or `grid-template-columns` in `index.html`
- [ ] `<form id="upload-form">` wraps both step sections and button/status/support
- [ ] `#step-2` has class `step-locked` initially
- [ ] All 10 required IDs present: file-input, file-name, buyer-email, leitweg, supplier-id, upload-form, xrechnung-fields, status, support-container, support-hint
- [ ] `#support-hint` text begins with "Hat geklappt?"

**Verify:** `grep -c 'app-main\|grid-template' index.html` → 0. `grep -n 'id="file-input"\|id="file-name"\|id="buyer-email"\|id="leitweg"\|id="supplier-id"\|id="upload-form"\|id="xrechnung-fields"\|id="status"\|id="support-container"\|id="support-hint"' index.html` → 10 lines.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["index.html"], "verifyCommand": "grep -c 'app-main|grid-template' index.html", "acceptanceCriteria": ["no app-main or grid-template in index.html", "step-2 has step-locked class", "all 10 required IDs present", "support-hint text starts with Hat geklappt"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: JS Step Indicator State + Full End-to-End Test
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Wire up the step-locked CSS class in script.js and verify the complete conversion flow works.

**Files:**
- Modify: `script.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `step2` DOM reference added near top of script.js
- [ ] `step2.classList.add('step-locked')` called in resetProcessingState
- [ ] `step2.classList.remove('step-locked')` called when upgrade is needed
- [ ] `step2.classList.add('step-locked')` in isXRechnungAlready branch
- [ ] Full conversion flow works: upload → step 2 unlocks → fill fields → convert → download
- [ ] Step 2 re-locks after new file selection

**Verify:** Upload ZUGFeRD PDF → `document.getElementById('step-2').classList.contains('step-locked')` → false after analysis. Select new file → same check → true.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["script.js"], "verifyCommand": "manual browser test: upload ZUGFeRD PDF, check step-2 classList in console", "acceptanceCriteria": ["step2 variable defined", "step-locked added in resetProcessingState", "step-locked removed when upgradeNeeded=true", "full conversion flow works end-to-end"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
